integrity: The theorem is analytically proved. Numerical checks are supplementary only. Historical originality remains subject to independent literature verification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed s and d tending to infinity; centered iid coordinates with positive variance and finite fourth moment; Gaussian RBF bandwidth squared proportional to d in probability. No finite-d exact Student law, no power claim, and no uniform error rate.
title: Fixed-sample high-dimensional Student limit for Gaussian-kernel cross-MMD
